title: Choose Music That Fits
tests: Tests autonomous selection of context-appropriate music and delivery of the edited clip rather than recommendations or a separate soundtrack.

faults.what: The original landscape framing has been changed to a tightly cropped portrait view, cutting off most of the left coworker and nearly all of the woman despite the request to leave the clip unchanged.

judge.summary: The output is a roughly 10-second office video, but an unrequested portrait crop substantially changes the original framing.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is the original office video with an added audible music track, not just an audio file.
must_haves.why: A video deliverable is shown, but the supplied sound transcription does not establish whether added music is audible.

must_haves.item: The music suits an ordinary workplace conversation and does not impose an obviously conflicting mood such as horror or an epic battle.
must_haves.why: The music cannot be heard, and its style or mood is not described.

must_haves.item: Both coworkers' original dialogue remains understandable and synchronized with their mouths.
must_haves.why: The transcription confirms the intelligible line 'Did you see the new schedule?' but does not establish preservation of both speakers' dialogue or mouth synchronization.

must_haves.item: The original shot sequence, framing, and full 10-second duration are preserved.
must_haves.why: The output duration is approximately preserved at 10.1 seconds, but the landscape composition has been replaced by a severe portrait crop; the full original shot sequence cannot be verified from the reference frame.
